training_config.alternative_explanation: The shared model can memorize one example per family yet fail to transfer across distinct calibration products because of family interference, inadequate capacity, or a train-calibration support shift.
training_config.claim_boundary: A single-seed local training and paired calibration-denoising pilot only; no heldout, unconditional generation, realism, synthesis-success, or model-promotion claim.
training_config.hypothesis: Equal-family balanced training will reduce paired fixed-corruption calibration loss in all twelve reaction families while preserving adapter-fixed states and Ugi exact-reconstruction behavior.
training_config.scientific_question: Does bounded realism-weighted training of one shared sparse flow improve denoising on every qualified reaction family's complete calibration partition without accessing heldout structures or generating molecules?
